spec.title: Codex subagents — provenance and evidence limits

p.GLM-BASELINE: The zai-glm-claude 1.1.0 protocol, packet template, provenance, manifest and boot snippet supplied the portable parent/worker lifecycle: narrow packets, scoped cwd, visible unstaged work, early reports, real exits, exact-process observation, preservation on failure and parent acceptance. They are historical design inputs, not live dependencies or provider authorization.

p.QUIET-INCIDENT: The host AGENTS.md ledger records a 2026-08-30 incident: plain codexrunner exec auto-loaded AGENTS.md and began the full roughly 145k-token boot before reading a quiet packet. A strict-config/ignore-user-config/project_doc_max_bytes=0 retry respected named inputs. The historical model/effort were gpt-5.6-sol/xhigh; those settings do not become this package defaults.

p.CLI-DISCOVERY: On 2026-10-01 local CLI 0.159.3 accepted the launcher options. POSIX fake-child contract tests passed 10/10. A live Linux read-only probe on an independently authenticated home returned QUIET_PROBE_OK with project_doc_max_bytes=0; the same conditional prompt with project_doc_max_bytes=4096 returned AUTO_BOOT_SENTINEL_PRESENT from automatically loaded AGENTS.md. Both exited zero and emitted no tool calls. Requested settings were gpt-6.1-sol/medium; resolved model and effective effort were absent from the JSONL metadata and remain unverified. Sanitized evidence lives in tests/evidence/2026-10-01-posix-quiet.json. Native Windows and macOS remain UNRUN. No account identity or credential values are evidence artifacts. This CLI result does not establish native-harness boot behavior.

p.LINUX-INSTALLED-USE: On 2026-10-01 VibeVM 1.1.0 installed this mutable 1.1.0 package offline and deployed the POSIX launcher with a verified reversible user receipt. The compact installed boot entry was unique and 28 lines. A real read-only Codex CLI worker, requested as gpt-6.1-sol/medium, checked root requirement, lock version, source/slot/deployed launcher byte equality, manifest identity, and boot pointer: five checks passed, child exit zero, no full boot or writes. Its search context exposed adjacent lines around named sections; this is recorded rather than presented as mechanical read confinement. Runtime model/effort metadata remain unverified. Sanitized evidence is retained in tests/evidence/2026-10-01-linux-install.json. Windows/macOS execution is not inferred from this Linux receipt.

p.OFFICIAL-REFERENCES: The official configuration reference at https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-reference documents project_doc_max_bytes and model_reasoning_effort. Authentication at https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/auth documents file-based credential storage under CODEX_HOME and interactive login. The GPT-6.1 Sol model page at https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol documents medium reasoning support; that does not establish any particular account's quota. Local CLI help and the live sentinel control are separate implementation evidence.

p.ISOLATION-CHANGE: This contract requires explicit absolute isolated CODEX_WORKER_HOME, file ChatGPT login and clearing inherited Codex/OpenAI auth/session routing. It does not inherit the GLM token source, endpoint, persistent Claude home, subscription entitlement or model routing. Account files, account-specific paths and token contents are never package artifacts.

p.QUIET-CHANGE: The marker moves to the first line of both packet and launch pointer. Parent-owned named rule selection and packet-defect stops replace implicit full boot. CLI suppression prevents instruction loading; it does not prove filesystem confinement. Native tools need separate host support.

p.BOUNDING-CHANGE: One observable outcome plus a closed contract defines boundedness. Token/line ceilings do not replace semantic scope or permit dropping hard requirements. Narrow meaningful oracles are mandatory; broad suites are not universal package law. Mutation checks are used only for suspicious cases or material false-green risk.

p.REQUEST-CHANGE: The new default requests gpt-6.1-sol at medium. Model requests, worker self-report and a successful fake CLI do not prove executed model or effective effort. Live metadata is reported only when actually observed.

p.EXCLUDED: Repository Cargo limits, campaign priorities, stewardship state, branch conventions, provider billing assumptions, quotas, account identity and host-specific model reserves remain outside the installed contract. Historical retired launchers need not be invoked or their secrets inspected.
